title: Ghost Army: The Artists Who Fought With Inflatable Tanks
summary: Tells how the eleven-hundred-man American 23rd Headquarters Special Troops, built from painters, designers and sound engineers, fooled German intelligence more than twenty times between Normandy and the Rhine using inflatable tanks, the sounds of fake units played through loudspeakers, and invented radio traffic. The episode runs from the weeks they spent filling the gap in Patton's front at Bettembourg to the Viersen deception at the Rhine crossing, the unit staying secret until nineteen ninety-six, and the Congressional Gold Medal it was awarded in twenty twenty-two.
